Alex R.: quick week0 check-in for SableHaven private/VPC onboarding. need final confirmation: route tables, IAM trust, CMK ARN, and an audit event to validate logs. renewal on watch so minimize blockers.
Devon N.: i can take network. ask them to run this from their bastion:

aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0f1e2d3c" --query 'RouteTables[*].{ID:RouteTableId,Routes:Routes}' --output json
aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0f1e2d3c" --query 'NatGateways[*].[NatGatewayId,State]' --output table

will also request traceroute to splunk-us.redwood.com during smoke.
Maria S.: KMS: request CMK ARN and include our log-forwarder principal in the key policy. prefer ExternalID in assume-role. if CMK blocks cross-account principals mark as blocker and provide policy wording.
Priya K.: retention decision: customer wants 365d, security recommends 90d. i've put both choices in the runbook with escalation steps. also added rollback criteria: abort if error rate >5% sustained 15m.
Ravi L.: renewal note: health at 68. propose milestone: complete dry-run with <=1 P1 blocker within 7 days -> bump health and exec touch. i'll prep incentive draft.
Alex R.: action items: Devon - send checklist to customer; Maria - share ExternalID template + policy snippet; Priya - finalize runbook text and capture retention decision; Ravi - prepare renewal incentive note. meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT with SableHaven infra lead. link sent.
Devon N.: sent checklist to customer thread, awaiting route-table IDs and SG IDs.
Maria S.: awaiting CMK ARN and sample assume-role policy.
Priya K.: runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sablehaven/week0.
Alex R.: thanks everyone. i'll post a short exec summary after the call. closing for now, will reopen with post-call notes. :white_check_mark:
